title: BanWords
description: A plugin to manage words in chat and punish players for saying them
body:
# BanWords
### By UncommonWindmill

A plugin to manage words in chat and punish players for those words.

Features:
- Detects words set by admins
- Automaticly mutes or bans the player (set by admin)
- Full configurable punishment history
- Exemptions for specific players
- Tab completion


Commands:

- /banword
- /banword add <word> <mute|ban> <duration>
- /banword remove <word>
- /banword edit <word> <mute|ban> <duration>
- /banword list
- /banword get <player>
- /banword history
- /banword historyclear
- /banword confirm
- /banword exempt <add|remove> <player>
- /banword exemptlist


(EssentialsX technically not required, but a plugin is needed that has the commands /tempban, /ban, and /mute, and has the same command format as EssentialsX)

⚠️Notice⚠️

There are preset words, exempt players, and history to provide examples

It is important to change/remove them through either the config.yml or using the built in commands (commands recommended)
